title: Empty state
overview: The region loaded; there is nothing to show. Say why and what they can do next.
apply_when: Empty list, empty search, 404-in-a-region, first-run with no items.
not_when: Still loading (skeleton / loading_indicator), or an error that blocked the load (alert).

role.overview: The region loaded; there is nothing to show. Say why and what they can do next.
role.apply_when: Empty list, empty search, 404-in-a-region, first-run with no items.
role.not_when: Still loading (skeleton / loading_indicator), or an error that blocked the load (alert).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: A reason plus a next step when a next step exists.

accessibility.overview: The empty region has a message AT can speak.
If there is a next step, it is a named control (button or link).
accessibility.apply_when: First-run or no-results with a clear action.

keyboard.overview: The next-step control is in the tab order.
keyboard.apply_when: An empty state with an action.
keyboard.not_when: The message is not reachable and there is no control.

keyboard.overview: Enter runs the next step when that control is focused.
keyboard.apply_when: A button or link in the empty state.
